creator: Alexander Terp
description:
On 0.27 and 0.28, a running Claude Code pane reported its title and turn endings up to close, and Cmd+Shift+T brought it back as a shell: `daemon.pane.reopened` with `agent=claude`, `resumed=false`, and no `session.id.reported` for the pane. Two of three reopens on 0.27.0 showed it.

Diagnosis: only the SessionStart hook reports the session id (`--from session-id=/session_id`); the statusline sends it as `context-session`, which does not set the resume command, and Stop reports only idle. Once the startup report is missed, nothing later fills it. A controlled repro on Claude Code 2.1.327 confirmed it: adding `--from session-id=/session_id` to the Stop hook's report built the resume command and reopen returned `resumed=true`.

Fix to test: report the id again from the main session's Stop hook; add a regression where SessionStart's report is missed and Stop's lands before close and reopen; capture failures of the startup report, which today discards stderr and masks its exit. From tooling feedback a_32HfzAknP.
title: Reopen Closed Pane drops a Claude session whose SessionStart report was missed
